#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p /logs/verifier
cd /app
TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
HIDDEN="$TESTS_DIR/hidden"
install_hidden() {
  rel="$1"
  dest="/app/$rel"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
  cp "$HIDDEN/$rel" "$dest"
}
checksum_fail() {
  echo 0 > /logs/verifier/reward.txt
  echo "test file modified: $1" >&2
  exit 1
}
